eyebrow: Two real ways to share storage
code:
SAN (Storage Area Network)
  connected via iSCSI or Fibre Channel
  presents LUNs every node can see

Storage Spaces Direct (S2D)
  pools local disks across nodes
  hyper-converged, no separate SAN box
caption: Different hardware, same goal: one consistent set of disks, visible to every node.
